23: /** Find the constraints to pass to Paragraph based on all the parameters. */
24: internal fun finalConstraints(
25:     constraints: Constraints,
26:     softWrap: Boolean,
27:     overflow: TextOverflow,
28:     maxIntrinsicWidth: Float,
29: ): Constraints =
30:     Constraints.fitPrioritizingWidth(
31:         minWidth = 0,
32:         maxWidth = finalMaxWidth(constraints, softWrap, overflow, maxIntrinsicWidth),
33:         minHeight = 0,
34:         maxHeight = constraints.maxHeight,
35:     )

37: /** Find the final max width a Paragraph would use based on all parameters. */
38: internal fun finalMaxWidth(
39:     constraints: Constraints,
40:     softWrap: Boolean,
41:     overflow: TextOverflow,
42:     maxIntrinsicWidth: Float,
43: ): Int {
44:     val widthMatters = softWrap || overflow.isEllipsis
45:     val maxWidth =
46:         if (widthMatters && constraints.hasBoundedWidth) {
47:             constraints.maxWidth
48:         } else {
49:             Constraints.Infinity
50:         }
51: 
52:     // if minWidth == maxWidth the width is fixed.
53:     //    therefore we can pass that value to our paragraph and use it
54:     // if minWidth != maxWidth there is a range
55:     //    then we should check if the max intrinsic width is in this range to decide the
56:     //    width to be passed to Paragraph
57:     //        if max intrinsic width is between minWidth and maxWidth
58:     //           we can use it to layout
59:     //        else if max intrinsic width is greater than maxWidth, we can only use maxWidth
60:     //        else if max intrinsic width is less than minWidth, we should use minWidth
61:     return if (constraints.minWidth == maxWidth) {
62:         maxWidth
63:     } else {
64:         maxIntrinsicWidth.ceilToIntPx().coerceIn(constraints.minWidth, maxWidth)
65:     }

conclusions: Material3 String Text with no callback/autosize delegates null values to BasicText. Without selection registrar, BasicText selects TextStringSimpleElement, not the MultiParagraph onTextLayout node. Both production tally count Text call sites and Setup ReadOnlyCount use this plain String/no-callback form.

The actual draw Paragraph is created using finalConstraints whose maxWidth is clamped to maxIntrinsicWidth within incoming min/max constraints. TextStringSimpleNode measures layoutSize and paints that same cached Paragraph.

Semantics GetTextLayoutResult invokes slowCreateTextLayoutResultOrNull, rebuilding a DIFFERENT MultiParagraph with prevConstraints.copyMaxDimensions(), while copying the original narrow layoutSize. Thus hasVisualOverflow and getBoundingBox may reflect wide reconstructed paragraph geometry, not the painted Paragraph.

Raw tally probe shows actual positive7/11/14/22px width after weighted-name correction while semantics paragraph is192px. Setup15 actual width17/34px has wider reconstructed paragraph75/129/133/160px. RTL coordinates far outside frame arise from this reconstruction; they do not independently prove rendered clipping.

Reject a Setup application-defect inference based solely on hasVisualOverflow or these reconstructed glyph bounds. Retain negative-control verification with production dimensions, actual count foreground pixels, expected text and adequate intrinsic width/paragraph height.

Numeric single-line proposed assertions are appropriate only with explicit restricted applicability; do not use them as a general multiline overflow oracle. Do not add onTextLayout to production merely to make assertions convenient, because that selects a different rendering path.
recommended_numeric_assertions: Select actual production unmerged numeric Text in exact row; assert expected numeric semantics and positive measured size.
Scroll actual count into viewport and assert displayed plus full frame containment.
Assert measured width>=ceil(reconstructed multiParagraph.intrinsics.maxIntrinsicWidth); intrinsic content width is independent of the surplus reconstruction constraints.
Assert one line and measured height>=ceil(reconstructed paragraph.height) for these unbroken numeric counts.

Capture actual count-only frame and require foreground-colored rendered pixel, not merely non-background color. Combine source proof with dimensions/pixel evidence; do not claim a screenshot-golden or every glyph raster match.
